notes.title: Lotus Reverie - Entering final stages of development
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24231268/66067f39a94cda0b8f4f95cab96e519ab0dac43b.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, and thank you for being around for so long.

I want to let you all know my next game Lotus Reverie is entering the final stages of development, a lot of announcement and a release date will be available soon!

For all of you interested you can join my Patreon and get different rewards. These rewards include:

- Early updates and Work in Progress
- Digital copies of the game on release
- Extras such as OST and artbook
- Access to Beta versions of the game and videos
- Hi res images and music
- Appear in the game with your own original character!
- Much more!

Please consider helping the development if you liked One Thousand Lies. Lotus Reverie is a project of passion, and I've been working on it really hard since I finished OTL.

patreon.com/keinart

Thank you very much.

notes.title: Better late than never - Donations
notes.content:
Some of you may have noticed the new DLC, donations:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/751700/Donation_Small/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/751701/Donation_Medium/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/751702/Donation_Big/

A lot of people actually asked for something like this before so they could simply donate or to at least get some advantages like not losing the game from your library after uninstalling.

Why I am adding this now, more than one year after release? The very first reason is because some people asked, but there's another reason: I'm right now developing my next game, and every penny helps. It is still unannounced and I can't really tell much yet, but the entire script is finished and we are basically working on the assets and programming now. I will let you all know more once it can come out to the world but all I can say it's going to be a lot bigger and better in every aspect!

Thanks for the support for so long and I'm glad to still see a lot of people enjoying this little novel I wrote as a hobby and experiment that I never thought it could receive so much love.


*EDIT: This post mentioned firstly trading cards, but it seems Steam doesn't accept them, here are their reason:

[i]Free products without in-app purchases cannot have Trading Cards. Trading cards for Free-to-Play games drop based on money spent on in-app purchases, which your game does not appear to have. Also be aware that money spent on DLC purchases does NOT count towards F2P trading cards drops.[/i]

So sorry for that!

notes.title: Soundtrack released as DLC
notes.content:
Just one little update for everyone: the Soundtrack of the novel is now also available to download as DLC on Steam, and of course is free too.

Here you can check it out: http://store.steampowered.com/app/464810

The music for this game was made by different artists and all of it is under a free license, so you can use however you want as long as it's not for commercial purposes.

The DLC page contains the entire tracklist with the artists names so if you like what you hear make sure to look for them and tell them personally how much you like their music. Protip: in the music room of the game, if you click on the artist name, you will open their official website or soundcloud page.

Hope you enjoy it and thanks again for reading One Thousand Lies.

notes.title: Steam Release
notes.content:
Hello there everyone, and thank you for checking out One Thousand Lies.

For those who don't know, One Thousand Lies is an indie kinetic visual novel I've been working on for quite some time. It was released the 28th of March on Itch.io (https://keinart.itch.io/one-thousand-lies) and since then a lot of people told me to try to go for a Steam release, and here we are. The game is currently waiting approval from the gods above and if everything goes well it will be released this 25th of April. If it doesn't it may be delayed just a bit, a week or so.

So what can you expect from One Thousand Lies? Well if you haven't read it yet you are probably thinking this looks like your generic school japanese-wannabe visual novel some NEET otaku made in his free time. To be honest, you are probably not so mistaken about the last part, but OTL is more than that. It's not your average "romance", you won't be seeing any "I hope senpai will notice me" neither you need to know your anime tropes because everything follow an European setting.

What I'm hoping with this novel is to give some messages, this novel contains some psychology and philosophical themes that I've not seen anywhere else so I kinda wanted to tackle them, but at the same time I didn't want to be the usual pretentious author thinking he's above everyone else. At the end, even if you don't pay attention to all these "deep conversations" you will get a funny comedy full of crazy moments, some nice characters, and, why not saying it, some waifus too.

I tried to make sure to make original humor and not just follow the memes like the trend that seems to go these days, and although the novel contain a lot of references for all kind of things, they are put there in a way you don't really need to understand them to get the joke.

In any case, it's around 7 hours long, and for free. So why don't you check it out? Follow it now so you can download it once it's released.

Thank you for your time and I hope you all enjoy reading One Thousand Lies.
